answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network binds each agent to a verifiable cryptographic identity through quadratic stake burning. When registering an isolated computational island, the agent burns tokens scaling as O(N^2) where N is the cluster size. This superlinear cost scaling ensures an attacker faces exponential capital attrition rather than a smooth velvet path. A consensus beacon acts like a lantern, slashing mirrored nodes to impose fatal economic friction.
